projectState.summary: Plan 0096 is a no-code calibration of the positive Plan 0095 corner. It holds the 35% amplitude anchor and harmonic-number decay fixed, compares 0x/2x/4x against the selected 6x reference, and isolates the 6x metal term. Full mixes are level-controlled, deterministic, aligned, and reconstruction-checked. A damped-guitar DI capture protocol is ready; motion-driven finger noise remains later.
